Partner with Zoot Web Agency Arlington’s results-driven web design specialists. Get your free website audit today.

Get My Free Proposal

Arlington Web Design Services

Professional web design and development services for Arlington businesses — every project is built around your goals, your customers, and the results you need your website to deliver.

Custom WordPress Web Design

We design and build bespoke WordPress websites from the ground up no generic templates, no page builder shortcuts that break on updates. Every site is built around your brand, your services, and how your customers actually navigate to a decision. We incorporate SEO best practices from the start, including clean site architecture, fast performance, keyword-focused page structures

Responsive Mobile-First Design

Over 60% of web traffic now comes from mobile devices. We design mobile-first, ensuring your site renders correctly across every screen size and device type before we even look at the desktop version. Google’s Core Web Vitals and mobile usability signals directly affect search rankings — responsive design is not optional.

Website Redesign

If your current website is outdated, slow, or not converting visitors into leads, we can rebuild it properly. We start by auditing what your existing site is doing well — particularly any SEO equity built up over time — and ensure the redesign improves on every metric without losing what is already working for your business.

eCommerce Web Design

We build eCommerce websites on WooCommerce and Shopify that are designed to convert browsers into buyers. Product page architecture, checkout flow, cart abandonment reduction, and mobile purchasing experience are all built into the design from the start — not bolted on later.

Landing Page Design

High-converting landing pages for paid search and social campaigns. We design pages built around a single goal — generating a lead, booking a call, completing a purchase — with no distractions, clear value propositions, and conversion elements placed where they are most effective based on heatmap and user behaviour data.

SEO-Friendly Development

A website that looks good but is difficult to find is a liability. We build sites with clean code, fast load speeds, proper semantic structure, schema markup, and all the technical SEO foundations that give your content the best possible chance of ranking. We also integrate arlington digital marketing strategies that support long-term visibility and audience growth

Website Maintenance & Support

Ongoing maintenance to keep your site secure, fast, and up to date. We handle plugin and theme updates, security monitoring, uptime checks, performance optimization, regular backups, and ongoing social media campaigns integration to ensure your website and online presence remain aligned across every channel. 

Shopify Store Design

Custom Shopify stores designed to maximise conversions. We handle theme customisation, app integration, product catalogue architecture, payment gateway setup, and the checkout experience. If you are migrating from another platform, we manage the full migration without losing your existing SEO rankings.

Hosting & Performance Optimisation

Slow websites lose visitors, conversions, and search rankings. We manage hosting, caching configuration, image optimization, CDN setup, and PPC landing page performance to ensure your site loads in under two seconds on every device.

Why Choose Zoot As Your Arlington Web Design Company

Most web design agencies focus on how a site looks. We focus on what it does. A beautiful website that does not generate leads is a liability, not an asset. Zoot Web Agency designs websites for Arlington businesses with one objective above all others: producing measurable business results. Every design decision, layout, copy, call-to-action placement, and page speed is evaluated against its impact on conversion rate and search visibility. Learn how conversion-focused websites improve lead generation and user experience through strategic design structure, mobile optimization, and performance-driven development.

Strategy Before Design

We do not start with visuals. We start by understanding your business goals, your customers' decision process, and what your site needs to do to move people from visitor to lead. Design follows strategy.

Mobile-First by Default

Every site we build is designed and tested on mobile before desktop. With the majority of search traffic on mobile devices, this is not a preference — it is a baseline requirement.

Speed-Optimised Builds

Page speed affects both user experience and search rankings. Every site we build is optimised for Core Web Vitals from the ground up — not patched afterwards.

Built for SEO

Clean semantic code, proper header hierarchy, schema markup, and technical SEO foundations are built into every project. A well-designed site should also rank.

Security-First Development

SSL, hardened WordPress configurations, regular update protocols, and secure coding practices are built into every project. We do not treat security as an afterthought.

Post-Launch Support

We provide ongoing support and maintenance after launch. You have a team to call when something needs updating, a question arises, or you want to expand the site.

Award-Winning Web Design Company in Arlington

Zoot Web Agency Named Top Digital Marketing Company by Clutch

Clutch evaluates B2B service providers using verified client interviews and independent market data. Zoot Web Agency holds a 5.0 rating and has been recognised as a top agency across SEO, PPC, Social Media, Web Design, and Digital Marketing categories.

Zoot Web Agency Named National Excellence Award Winner by UpCity

UpCity’s Recommendability Rating evaluates credibility, client satisfaction, and online reputation independently. Zoot Web Agency holds a 5.0 rating on UpCity and has been recognised as a National Excellence Award winner.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions from Arlington businesses about web design services, timelines, and what to expect from a website project with Zoot Web Agency.

How long does a website project take for a Arlington business?
A typical brochure website takes four to eight weeks from project kick-off to launch. eCommerce projects and larger sites with custom functionality typically take eight to sixteen weeks. We provide a detailed project timeline at the proposal stage so you know exactly what to expect and when.
Will my new website rank on Google?
Yes — SEO is built into every site we develop. We handle technical SEO foundations including clean code structure, page speed optimisation, schema markup, mobile responsiveness, and Core Web Vitals compliance. On-page content optimisation is included. If you need an ongoing SEO campaign after launch, that is a separate service we also offer.
Do you work with existing websites or only build new ones?
Both. We redesign existing websites as well as building from scratch. When redesigning, we audit what is working on your current site — particularly any SEO rankings and traffic — and ensure the new site improves on every metric without losing equity that has already been built.
What platform will my website be built on?
The majority of our projects use WordPress, which gives you full ownership and editorial control without needing a developer for day-to-day updates. For eCommerce, we use WooCommerce or Shopify depending on your requirements. We discuss platform options during the proposal stage.
Will I be able to update the website myself after launch?
Yes. We build sites on content management systems that allow non-technical users to update pages, add blog posts, and manage content without developer assistance. We provide training as part of every project handover.
How much does a professional website cost for a $_cn business?
Website pricing depends on the scope, complexity, and functionality required. A professional brochure site typically starts at a few thousand dollars. eCommerce and larger builds with custom functionality are priced higher. We provide a fixed-scope proposal based on a clear brief after an initial consultation — you know exactly what you are getting before any work begins.

items.q: Do you work with existing websites or only build new ones?
items.a: Both. We redesign existing websites as well as building from scratch. When redesigning, we audit what is working on your current site — particularly any SEO rankings and traffic — and ensure the new site improves on every metric without losing equity that has already been built.

items.q: What platform will my website be built on?
items.a: The majority of our projects use WordPress, which gives you full ownership and editorial control without needing a developer for day-to-day updates. For eCommerce, we use WooCommerce or Shopify depending on your requirements. We discuss platform options during the proposal stage.

items.q: Will I be able to update the website myself after launch?
items.a: Yes. We build sites on content management systems that allow non-technical users to update pages, add blog posts, and manage content without developer assistance. We provide training as part of every project handover.

items.q: How much does a professional website cost for a $_cn business?
items.a: Website pricing depends on the scope, complexity, and functionality required. A professional brochure site typically starts at a few thousand dollars. eCommerce and larger builds with custom functionality are priced higher. We provide a fixed-scope proposal based on a clear brief after an initial consultation — you know exactly what you are getting before any work begins.
